objective: From the transcript, produce a LinkedIn post and, independently, a short-video script plus a summary. Also answer the customer's support question using only the supplied knowledge source.

context.transcript: [Test transcript written for this end-to-end test] Today I want to talk about why most automation projects fail. In our team we automated invoice processing last year. The first attempt failed because we automated a broken process: approvals bounced between three people and nobody owned exceptions. So step one was mapping the process on a whiteboard and removing two approval steps. Step two, we started with the most boring, high-volume case: standard supplier invoices, about 70 percent of our volume. Step three, every exception went to one named owner with a 24-hour response rule. After three months, the average processing time dropped from 6 days to 2 days.
context.question: How do I download my course certificate as a PDF?

knowledge_sources.title: Certificates FAQ (test source)
knowledge_sources.content: Certificates are issued when all lessons in a course are completed. To download one, open My Learning, select the course, then click 'Certificate' and choose 'Download PDF'. Certificates cannot be edited after issue.
